mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_place_logs (trip_id, place_id, name, memo, linked_expense_id, visited_at, detected_by_gps) VALUES (#{trip_id}, #{place_id}, #{name}, #{memo}, #{linked_expense_id}, #{visited_at}, #{detected_by_gps})
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.trip_id, l.place_id, l.name, l.memo, l.linked_expense_id, l.visited_at, l.detected_by_gps, l.created_at, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.emoji AS place_emoji FROM trip_place_logs l LEFT JOIN places p ON p.id = l.place_id WHERE l.trip_id = #{trip_id} ORDER BY l.display_order ASC, l.visited_at ASC, l.id ASC

SELECT l.id, l.trip_id, l.place_id, l.name, l.memo, l.linked_expense_id, l.visited_at, l.detected_by_gps, l.created_at, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.emoji AS place_emoji FROM trip_place_logs l LEFT JOIN places p ON p.id = l.place_id WHERE l.trip_id = #{tripId} AND l.id = #{logId}
mapper.update:
UPDATE trip_place_logs
name = #{request.name},
memo = #{request.memo},
visited_at = #{request.visitedAt},
place_id = #{request.placeId},
detected_by_gps = #{request.detectedByGps},
WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND id = #{logId}
